    (uniform : ∀ c ∈ C, ∀ x, c x = b) (n : Nat) (t : Tree X (n + 1)) :
    ¬ PathConsistent C t := by
  cases t with
  | branch x l r =>
      intro h
      cases b with
      | false =>
          obtain ⟨c, hc, hx⟩ := h.1
          have incompatible : (true : Bool) = false := by
            trace_state
            exact hx.symm.trans (uniform c hc x)
          cases incompatible
      | true =>
          obtain ⟨c, hc, hx⟩ := h.2.1
          have incompatible : (false : Bool) = true := by
            trace_state
            exact hx.symm.trans (uniform c hc x)
          cases incompatible
